create_emu3_image_processor: create an Emu3ImageProcessor instance with configurable resize, rescale, and normalize settings
run_smart_resize: run smart_resize to dynamically resize image dimensions divisible by a factor within pixel bounds
build_image_preprocess_pipeline: build an image preprocessing pipeline that resizes, converts to RGB, rescales, normalizes, and pads batches
test_image_postprocess: test image postprocess to reverse preprocessing by unnormalizing, rescaling, and converting back to PIL images
review_unnormalize_method: review the unnormalize method that reverses normalization using mean and standard deviation values
